item.extinction.celestial_lure.desc: Calls the asteroid down where you look. There is no going back.
extinction.title.warning: The Last Days of the Cretaceous
extinction.subtitle.impact: Chicxulub. A 10 km asteroid strikes at 20 km per second
extinction.subtitle.firestorm: Ejecta rains back down across the whole world
extinction.subtitle.volcanism: Flood basalts choke the air with ash and acid
extinction.subtitle.winter: Soot blots out the sun. The food chain collapses
extinction.subtitle.recovery: Life returns, but the dinosaurs are gone
extinction.subtitle.over: The Age of Mammals has begun
extinction.narration.warning.0: A new star has appeared in the sky. It was not there last night.
extinction.narration.warning.1: The star is brighter now, bright enough to see by day. The herds have gone quiet.
extinction.narration.warning.2: The ground trembles. Every animal that can run is running.
extinction.narration.warning.3: It has a tail now. It is not a star. Get underground.
extinction.lure.wrong_dimension: The Celestial Lure only works in the Overworld.
extinction.command.started: The extinction has begun. The asteroid will strike near %s, %s.
extinction.command.stopped: The extinction event was stopped. Changes already made to the world stay.
extinction.command.bad_phase: Unknown phase. Use warning, impact, firestorm, volcanism, winter or recovery.
extinction.command.no_players: No player in the Overworld to aim at. Use /extinction start <x> <z>.
death.attack.extinction.impact: %1$s was vaporized by the asteroid impact
death.attack.extinction.impact.player: %1$s was vaporized by the asteroid impact whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.extinction.shockwave: %1$s was flattened by the impact shockwave
death.attack.extinction.shockwave.player: %1$s was flattened by the impact shockwave whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.extinction.tsunami: %1$s was swept away by the megatsunami
death.attack.extinction.tsunami.player: %1$s was swept away by the megatsunami whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.extinction.ejecta.player: %1$s was struck by burning ejecta whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.extinction.heat: %1$s was cooked by the glowing sky
death.attack.extinction.heat.player: %1$s was cooked by the glowing sky whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.extinction.acid_rain.player: %1$s dissolved in the acid rain whilst fighting %2$s
extinction.event.great_dying.traps.sub: A continent splits open and floods with lava
extinction.event.great_dying.winter.sub: Sulfur blots out the sun and the acid rain begins
extinction.event.great_dying.hothouse.su: Carbon dioxide cooks the planet. The rivers boil away
extinction.event.great_dying.anoxia.sub: The oceans lose their oxygen and turn to poison
extinction.event.great_dying.dying.sub: Nine in ten species are gone
extinction.event.great_dying.end.sub: The worst extinction in Earth's history is over
extinction.event.snowball_earth.freeze.s: The ice is spreading from the poles
extinction.event.snowball_earth.blizzard: Find fire. Find shelter. Do not stay outside
extinction.event.snowball_earth.snowball: Ice from pole to equator. The seas are frozen solid
extinction.event.snowball_earth.thaw.sub: Volcanic carbon dioxide finally warms the world
extinction.event.supervolcano.unrest.sub: The ground is swelling. Steam is pouring from the cracks
extinction.event.supervolcano.eruption.s: A thousand cubic kilometres of magma, all at once
extinction.event.supervolcano.flows.sub: Avalanches of burning gas race out at hundreds of km per hour
extinction.event.supervolcano.winter.sub: Ash blocks out the sun for a decade
extinction.event.supervolcano.end.sub: For another six hundred thousand years
extinction.event.gamma_ray_burst.burst.s: A star collapsed six thousand light years away
extinction.event.gamma_ray_burst.ozone.s: The sun burns. Stay out of the daylight
extinction.event.gamma_ray_burst.brown_s: Nitrogen dioxide smothers the sky. A long cold begins
extinction.event.solar_superflare.sunspo: The Sun is covered in dark scars. The aurora reaches the equator
Ten thousand times the Carrington Event
extinction.event.solar_superflare.aurora: The storm passes. The sky still glows
extinction.event.great_deluge.rains.sub: It has been raining for forty days
Winds of five hundred km per hour, waterspouts, storm surges
extinction.event.great_deluge.deluge.sub: The sea has swallowed the land. Get to high ground
extinction.event.tornado_outbreak.superc: The sky has turned green. Hail the size of fists
extinction.event.tornado_outbreak.outbre: Dozens of tornadoes on the ground at once
extinction.event.comet_swarm.shower.sub: The Earth is crossing the trail of a broken comet
extinction.event.comet_swarm.airbursts.s: Tunguska, again and again. The forests are lying flat
extinction.event.comet_swarm.impacts.sub: The big pieces reach the ground
extinction.event.comet_swarm.cold_snap.s: Soot and dust plunge the world back into an ice age
extinction.event.great_rift.rift.sub: The continent is tearing in two
extinction.event.great_rift.sea.sub: A new ocean is being born
extinction.event.great_rift.end.sub: Where your home used to be
extinction.event.shattered_moon.tides.su: Without the Moon, the oceans go mad
extinction.event.shattered_moon.end.sub: Only a ring of dust and stone remains
extinction.subtitle.pyroclastic: Run. It is faster than you
death.attack.extinction.pyroclastic: %1$s was incinerated by a pyroclastic flow
death.attack.extinction.pyroclastic.play: %1$s was incinerated by a pyroclastic flow whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.extinction.radiation: %1$s was burned to death by radiation
death.attack.extinction.radiation.player: %1$s was burned to death by radiation whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.extinction.toxic: %1$s was poisoned by the dying sea
death.attack.extinction.toxic.player: %1$s was poisoned by the dying sea whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.extinction.tornado: %1$s was torn apart by the storm
death.attack.extinction.tornado.player: %1$s was torn apart by the storm whilst fighting %2$s
